decisions.decision: Don't wait for T-050/T-051. Both are Claude's queue items, so write the copy now in the Backlinko voice from COPY_RULES.md. Never write a literal cohort date; use rolling cohort tokens. Then, in cloud/src, add a pushToCampaign(attendee, 'pre'|'post') job. It uses the same POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts import as T-234 (integrations-tantra-api.md s5). Call it on sign-up for the pre campaign and when Day 3 ends for the cohort for the post campaign. Make it idempotent with a per-attendee D1 ledger in a new migration. Add admin fields for the pre and post campaign ids, and write a campaign setup spec carrying the copy. Prove it with a simulator probe using the [email] test identity ('Adi test'): sign-up import, Day 3 import, no duplicates, and no n8n/Instantly/SendGrid/Twilio in the path. Ship with the Tantra push turned off until the key exists. Don't open a new ask; the key ask is already on T-234/T-228. Set the task to review after the live test.
